name: Some Plus Bulk Manager
author: someplus

sections.description:
Some Plus Bulk Manager helps you clean up and optimize your WordPress site with powerful bulk operations. All deletions are stored in a trash system, allowing you to undo accidental deletions within 30 days.

Key Features:

  • Trash & Undo System – All deleted items are stored for 30 days with full restore capability
  • User Management – Delete inactive users, clean up BuddyPress pending signups, remove orphan user meta
  • Media Cleanup – Find and delete orphaned media files, large files, and unused attachments
  • Content Management – Delete post revisions, auto-drafts, trashed posts, and duplicate content
  • Comment Cleanup – Remove spam comments, unapproved comments, and orphan comment meta
  • Database Optimization – Clean expired transients, orphan post meta, and optimize tables
  • Scheduled Cleanups – Schedule automatic cleanup tasks (daily, weekly, monthly)
  • Safety Features – Dry-run mode to preview changes, maximum limits, nonce verification, capability checks

Supported Operations:

  • Inactive users (by login time and role)
  • BuddyPress pending signups
  • Orphaned user meta
  • Orphaned media attachments
  • Large files by size
  • Post revisions
  • Auto-drafts
  • Trashed posts
  • Spam and unapproved comments
  • Orphaned comment meta
  • Expired transients
  • Orphaned post meta
  • WooCommerce orphaned product images
  • WooCommerce old orders
  • WooCommerce unused coupons
  • Duplicate content detection
  • Broken links scanning

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/some-plus-bulk-manager/, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ‘Bulk Manager’ in the admin menu to start cleaning up your site.
sections.faq:
Can I undo deletions?

Yes! All deletions are stored in a trash system for 30 days. You can restore deleted items from the “Trash & Undo” section at any time during this period.

Is it safe to use?

Yes. The plugin includes several safety features:
– Dry-run mode to preview all changes before executing
– Maximum limit of 5000 records per operation
– Server-side validation to prevent exceeding previewed counts
– Admin capability checks (manage_options required)
– Nonce verification for all operations

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! The plugin includes a dedicated WooCommerce module (visible when WooCommerce is active) for cleaning up:
– Orphaned product images
– Old orders by status
– Unused coupons
– Cart session data

Does it work with BuddyPress?

Yes! The plugin can clean up unactivated BuddyPress signups (pending registrations).

Can I schedule cleanups?

Yes! You can schedule cleanup tasks to run automatically on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis.

What happens after 30 days in trash?

Items in trash are automatically deleted permanently after 30 days via a scheduled cleanup task.
